title: SQL Foundations
description: Read and write the SQL behind every CRUD app: filtering, NULLs, aggregates, joins, writes, schema design, indexes, transactions, injection safety, what EF Core sends to the database, CTEs, pivots, dates and time zones, safe migrations, execution plans, and deadlocks. Runnable exercises model each clause over arrays of rows so you internalize exactly what the query does.
outcomes: Write SELECT queries with WHERE, ORDER BY, and stable OFFSET/FETCH paging
Predict how NULL and three-valued logic change filters, NOT IN, and aggregates
Summarize data with COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY, and HAVING
Choose INNER, LEFT, and self joins and spot row fan-out before it inflates totals
Use window functions for running totals and rankings without collapsing rows
Write safe UPDATE, DELETE, and atomic upsert statements
Design tables with keys, constraints, and junction tables for 1:N and M:N data
Explain which predicates a composite B-tree index can seek on
Reason about transactions, isolation levels, and lost updates
Parameterize every query and recognize the N+1 problem in EF Core
Write CTEs and recursive CTEs to walk org charts and category trees
Choose between joins, IN, and EXISTS, and write NULL-safe anti-joins
Pivot data with CASE expressions and conditional aggregation
Store instants in UTC, filter with half-open ranges, and bucket by day in the right time zone
Use string functions, LIKE patterns, and collations without losing index seeks
Explain when views and stored procedures help, and ship schema changes with expand/contract migrations and batched backfills
Read an execution plan to find scans, misestimates, and key lookups, and fix them with the right index
Recognize deadlocks, prevent them with consistent lock ordering, and retry the victim
